setup.title: Build automations with AI
setup.intro: FLODE can create automations from a description and explain why a run did (not) work. It uses the AI you set up in Home Assistant – FLODE itself needs no key.
setup.step1: Pick a provider below – Home Assistant opens its setup. Ollama runs locally for free, the others need an API key from the provider.
setup.step2: Enter the key or the Ollama address. Home Assistant creates an "AI Task" along the way.
setup.step3: Choose the new AI under Settings → System → AI → "AI suggestions" → "Data generation tasks" and save. Then "Create with AI" appears in FLODE.
setup.agentStep1: You already have an AI assistant ({{agents}}). Open its integration under "Devices & services" and add an "AI Task" service there.
setup.agentStep2: Choose the new AI Task under Settings → System → AI → "AI suggestions" → "Data generation tasks" and save. Then "Create with AI" appears in FLODE.
setup.privacy: When used, your description plus names and IDs of matching entities are sent to the chosen provider. Nothing is saved unless you save it.
setup.defaultStep: You already have an AI with an "AI Task", but none is chosen yet. Pick it under Settings → System → AI → "AI suggestions" → "Data generation tasks" and save – then "Create with AI" appears in FLODE.
